title: ccusage, read like a tree

specimen.common: ccusage, the coding-agent usage CLI, cut at HEAD
specimen.note: In May 2026 a native Rust CLI arrives and pulls the trunk hard towards rust/. Before that come a flush of growth in the first month and a thin winter; the outer weekly rings are the widest since the first summer.

events.title: Implemented by Claude Code
events.note: the first commit message says so

events.title: 278 commits in one week
events.note: v9.0.0 to v15.0.0 in seven days

epilogue: Seventy-four weekly rings and 2,729 commits. Pricing snapshots and generated files sit inside rust/ too, which is part of why that folder dominates the outer wood; the ring reader lists each week's largest commits so you can see what is code and what is data.
